event: Remaining hemp redefinition (P.L. 119-37 § 781) takes full effect when the H.R. 6500 § 2019 delay ends, unless Congress acts: THC measured as total THC including THCA; cannabinoids synthesized outside the plant excluded; final products capped at 0.4 mg per container, and intermediate products at 0.3%, of combined total THC plus THC-like cannabinoids (as HHS determines); intermediate products may not be sold to consumers. Stopgap funding under H.R. 6500 § 106(3) also runs until Dec. 11.

Deadline for hemp licensees that will store over-limit hemp-derived products (made or procured compliantly before Dec. 11) in a quarantine area to list them on the Hemp Quarantine 2026 document and submit it to the Cannabis Control Commission

Cannabis Control Commission begins treating hemp-derived products over the limits in its Bulletin 2026-7 (0.4 mg total THC per container for final products; 0.3% total THC, dry weight, for intermediates) as noncompliant, including website listings. Compliant pre-Dec. 11 stock listed by Dec. 4 may be held in a designated quarantine area, but not processed, moved, distributed or sold unless federal officials or the CCC allow it. Dates may change with federal delays or guidance
